goal: Electron client-only desktop with SSH/SFTP file workflows, read-only viewers, explicit remote exec and PTY; implement only on a subsequent user instruction.
assumptions: Existing SSH account and feature-specific permissions; SFTP, exec and PTY may be independently restricted.
